text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":100,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"100 math problems"},{"id":"q2","value":12,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"12 problems on Monday"},{"id":"q3","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"3 times as many"},{"id":"q4","value":1,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"one-quarter"},{"id":"q5","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"one-quarter"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"Tuesday's completed problems are 3 times Monday's 12; multiply them"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"add Monday and Tuesday completed problems together"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract problems completed so far from the 100 total to find the remaining problems before Wednesday"},{"op":"div","args":["s3","q5"],"out":"s4","note":"divide the remaining problems by 4 to find one quarter of them, completed on Wednesday"},{"op":"sub","args":["s3","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"subtract Wednesday's completed quarter from the remaining problems to get how many are left for Thursday"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"math problems Chris has left to complete on Thursday"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"the word 'one' in 'one-quarter' is the fraction numerator; multiplying by 1 doesn't change the amount, so only the denominator (4) is needed to compute one quarter via division"}]}
